thesis: Ben Horowitz and Balaji Srinivasan argue that network states represent the next phase of governance by integrating existing digital primitives like Bitcoin, Discord, and stablecoins into a unified system that can replace traditional institutions such as money, law, and governance. They suggest that while the individual technological components have been mature for some time, the true value emerges only when these pieces are successfully integrated to create internet-first communities that can scale and coordinate legitimacy.
